_comment: Rollout config. rollout_start_date marks when this pace took effect. Edit posts_per_day / windows_et as needed - no need to touch the workflow file to change pace.
timezone_note: windows_et are in US Eastern local time (America/New_York) and are DST-safe - the scheduler converts them to UTC/IST at run time using zoneinfo, so they stay correct across the Nov/Mar DST switch.
randomness_note: Six 4-hour windows tile the whole ET day; the scheduler picks a genuinely random minute inside each, so there is exactly one post per 4-hour block at an unpredictable time. To avoid overnight posts, shorten the first window (e.g. 05:00-07:59) or drop it and set posts_per_day to 5.
watch_for: Average view duration and subscriber growth at 1/day pace
Any Content ID claim, community guideline strike, or 'limited/no ads' flag on recent uploads
Any YouTube Studio notice about reused/repetitious or spam content
